profile.about: I hold an engineering degree in embedded systems with strong theoretical training complemented by practical internships. I master design and project management tools and excel at solving complex problems and innovating. Motivated and engaged, I seek to bring my technical skills and teamwork spirit to a dynamic company.

hermes.title: Hermes Project – Support Drone (PDS)
hermes.description: Embedded C and Android Java development for a secure communication demonstrator between units using a relay drone simulated on Raspberry Pi. Implemented proprietary Protobuf protocol, secured TCP+TLS, video/image processing and QR code detection.
hermes.context: ESEO / Industrial project supervised by Thales

enhanced_ubuntu.title: Enhanced Ubuntu Desktop Experience
enhanced_ubuntu.description: Automated installer script to transform Ubuntu Desktop into a customized, elegant GNOME environment. Interactive menu, backup/restore, robust error handling and automatic extension activation.

monopoly_zapped.title: Monopoly Zapped (Android)
monopoly_zapped.description: Mobile app reimplementation of the interactive game Monopoly Zapped in Java/Kotlin with modular architecture and modern Android UI/UX.

backup_ubuntu.title: Backup Ubuntu (Bash)
backup_ubuntu.description: Advanced backup/restore script using rsync with configurable NAS/local options and interactive CLI interface.

infrastructure.title: Personal Infrastructure (Sysadmin/DevOps)
infrastructure.description: Self-hosted environment: NAS, reverse proxy, Docker services, Proxmox virtualization and secure web services with SSL.

stage_technique.title: Technical Internship – Documentation & POCs
stage_technique.description: Documentation and multiple POCs exploring modern web technologies: NestJS, MongoDB Atlas, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Keycloak and real-time sync solutions.
